Hi, I’m Anna Tam Ly! 👋

* 📖 I’m completing an MSc in Mathematical and Statistical Sciences, specializing in Modelling, Data, and Predictions, at the University of Alberta.
* 📘 I completed an HBSc at the University of Toronto, with a double major in Mathematics and Quantitative Biology and a minor in Statistics.
* 💻 I use data science, machine learning, and mathematical and statistical modelling to analyze complex data and build practical tools.
* 🌱 I’m interested in applying these skills to biology, public health, and other real-world problems.
